title: Entry & Patio Door Contracts: Standard Size Schedule and Custom-Size Surcharge
content:
Every door series of the Entry & Patio Door Contracts line has a fixed list of standard nominal sizes, written as width by height in inches. Any other measured size is a custom size, and the series sets a surcharge per door unit measured at a custom size.

## Standard sizes and custom-size surcharge by series

| Door series | Standard nominal sizes (width by height, inches) | Custom-size surcharge per door unit |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door | 32x80, 34x80, 36x80 | $295.00 |
| Ridgeline Portal 520 Smooth Fiberglass Entry Door | 32x80, 34x80, 36x80, 36x96 | $345.00 |
| Ridgeline Glide 720 Vinyl Sliding Patio Door | 60x80, 72x80, 96x80 | $385.00 |
| Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door | 32x80, 34x80, 36x80, 36x96 | $395.00 |
| Ridgeline Glide 840 Fiberglass Sliding Patio Door | 60x80, 72x80, 96x80 | $465.00 |
| Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door | 60x80, 64x80, 72x80 | $540.00 |

## Points of reading

- A size is standard only for the series whose list contains it. The 36x96 entry size appears in the lists of the Ridgeline Portal 520 Smooth Fiberglass Entry Door and the Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door, and not in the list of the Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door, so a 36x96 unit is a custom size in the Portal 310 series.
- The 64x80 patio size is standard only in the Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door list; the 96x80 size is standard in the Ridgeline Glide 720 Vinyl Sliding Patio Door and Ridgeline Glide 840 Fiberglass Sliding Patio Door lists and not in the Hinge 960 list.
- The surcharge is stated per door unit. Hypothetical: two custom-size units in the Ridgeline Glide 720 series correspond to two times $385.00, that is $770.00.
